The most specific rule wins on its own: a product rule over a brand rule, and a brand rule over a category rule, block by block, so a product rule with only an update date still takes the repair from its brand rule. Priority only decides between two rules of the same kind; on a tie, the oldest.

La priorità decide solo tra due regole dello stesso tipo; a parità, la più vecchia.
